title: Italia, 1 dollar, Amber Route

specs.Decoration: high relief, antique finish, amber insert

descriptionPlain: Description The Amber Road was an ancient trade route connecting the Baltic coast with the Mediterranean region, existing from the Bronze Age to the Middle Ages. It ran through what is now Poland, the Czech Republic, Austria and Italy, connecting Pomerania with Aquileia. It fostered the development of cities and the exchange of goods, cultures and ideas. Discover the secrets of the Amber Route and collect all nine coins in this unique series.
